faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur (IIEST Shibpur) for a research project position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Project Associate - I under the Department of Information Technology for a project related to Quantum-Resistant Cryptography.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Associate - I position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BTech, BSc, or MSc degree in IT, CST, ETC, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Associate - I position is 32 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the consolidated salary offered for this project post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,500/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application through the Google Form and email soft copies is 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate - I position is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026 at IIEST, Shibpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online via the provided Google Form and also submit their application documents via email.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application details?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details, Google Form link, and email instructions in the important links section of this article.
